bootstrap.unit: intact pair within each of two fixed seed blocks

estimand: equal-weight mean of two block1-meanGovernor/meanPI; no selected primary or scalar objective
missing: retain all16 assigned slots and8 pairs; unavailable metrics/intervals stay null; no successful-only means
sampling: GT native timestamp primary representation with20ms/+10ms grid sensitivity; no favorable-grid selection

windows.primary: first recorded positive-obstacle manifold +0.05s to +3.0s; fixed for both arms; not guaranteed to remove entire first-impact tail
windows.whole_route: unchanged first control input through final action end
windows.recovery: existing concurrent CRUISE scale>=0.98, executed v>=0.392m/s, body v>=0.95 precontact median sustained0.3s after contact end
windows.negative_control: precontact approach and first50ms only when every GT/joint interpolation support precedes the first reduced executed command; otherwise mark contaminated/unavailable, never use it as a causal negative control

measurement.native: Keep replay and native scores unchanged, separate namespace
measurement.vertical: Unfiltered original IMU header-time samples; sample RMS and peak; raw values retained; existing signal_stats coverage>=0.98
measurement.slip: gt_timestamp_series + integrate at original GT stamps; interpolate joints only, maxgap10.001ms, no extrapolation; same ratio clipping/denominator; slip_square_per_m units s/m, not joules
measurement.sensitivity: Retain original-GT slip plus existing20ms grid and+10ms shifted grid on same windows. Require same direction for primary slip effect; report all. No downsampling IMU to10Hz for scoring, no favorable grid selection.
measurement.protection: No spike removal, no zero imputation, no changes to historical studies/models or parameter configuration

timing: existing causal read_evidence checks; report available opportunity and body/wheel snapshots without claiming identified motor latency
comparability: report existing approach checks without dropping or replacing attempts
limitations: one fixed6mm rigid obstacle; seeds label repeated cold starts, not new terrain or exact-state branching; no sim-to-real or H3 claim
